name: @streamarr-tv/app-webos
description: Streamarr webOS TV app shell: bootstraps @streamarr-tv/ui-tv + @streamarr-tv/player-shaka. Bundled with Vite to static assets, then packaged with the webOS CLI (ares-package) -- see README.md, the CLI is not installed in this environment.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs
scripts.package:ipk: pnpm run build && ares-package dist -o out
